name: What is the difference between custom and semi-custom residential construction?
description: Custom builds offer total design flexibility from scratch, whereas semi-custom homes modify an established floor plan with predetermined finish options.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between custom and semi-custom residential construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom homes are designed entirely around your specific lot and living preferences, while semi-custom homes adapt pre-existing floor plans. With a custom home, you retain complete control over room layouts, ceiling heights, energy systems, and aesthetic details, but it demands longer design timelines and larger upfront planning budgets. Semi-custom builds allow cosmetic finish choices from a set catalog, which reduces design fees and shortens lead times but restricts structural modifications.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom builds offer total design flexibility from scratch, whereas semi-custom homes modify an established floor plan with predetermined finish options.
